contributions.detail: Form A carries ONE inked row, 104.31, and the sheet's printed TOTAL reads 104.31 -- the two agree exactly, and both equal the cover's line-1 TOTALS FROM THIS REPORT cell. They do NOT equal the CUMULATIVE cell (105.41 = 1.10 carried from the prior report + 104.31), so THE SCOPE IS PERIOD, a different scope from the cumulative figure this module publishes; per the addendum reconciles_* is expected to stay blank for that and it is not a failure. Line 2 (the $50.00-or-less aggregate) is BLANK in all three columns, so the sub-$50 trap does not arise and scoring against line 1 is unambiguous. The cover's own horizontal chain closes exactly: 1.10 + 104.31 = 105.41.

expenditures.detail: Form B (page 3) is a WHOLLY EMPTY grid -- every data cell blank, nothing struck out -- and its printed TOTAL cell is left EMPTY (not a dash, not a zero glyph). Cover line 3 is likewise blank in all three columns. There is therefore no printed figure to score the empty side against, so the result is 'unknown' rather than 'exact'. The side itself is an honest zero: sides.expenditures = 'transcribed' with zero rows, not a gap and not a withholding.

gates.page_subtotal: This form generation prints schedule totals on both sheets. p2: the single row 104.31 = the printed TOTAL 104.31 -- gates exactly, and that figure in turn equals cover line1-THIS. p3: the grid is empty and the printed TOTAL cell is blank, so no gate exists to fire there; reported rather than invented. Nothing failed to gate on this filing.

gates.balance_chain: Line 1 closes exactly: 1.10 (LAST) + 104.31 (THIS) = 105.41 (CUMULATIVE). The full beginning + contributions - expenditures = ending chain CANNOT be evaluated, because line 3 (expenses) is blank in all three columns and line 4 (balance) is filled ONLY in the CUMULATIVE cell, where it reads 105.41 -- consistent with 105.41 contributed and nothing spent, but resting on a blank rather than a printed zero, so it is reported and not asserted. No earlier filing by this filer is in my chunk, so the cover-to-cover CUMULATIVE -> TOTALS FROM LAST REPORT test could not be run; a human wanting to verify the 1.10 LAST cell must pull Dean J. Cox's preceding 2020 filing.

notes: Generation-2 county-branded form ('WASHINGTON COUNTY CANDIDATE FINANCIAL CAMPAIGN REPORT', law cited as Washington County Code 1-7-1), filled out in blue ink. CHUNK FILE AGREES WITH THE DOCUMENT: candidate 'Dean J. Cox' matches the cover's Full Name of Candidate, and office 'Commission Seat C' matches the cover's Office line, which reads verbatim 'Wash Co. Commission Seat C'. County office, in scope. Addressed to County Clerk 'Kim Hafen'; certified period 'beginning 6-16-2020 and ending 10-20-2020'; signature dated 10-20-2020; clerk RECEIVED stamp OCT 20 2020. The index path's embedded '10-21-2020' matches neither; the DOCUMENT governs and the discrepancy is recorded here rather than resolved. THE ONLY CONTRIBUTION ON THE FILING IS FROM THE CANDIDATE HIMSELF -- Form A's single row names 'Dean Cox' at the same street address the cover gives as the candidate's home. Unlike the Iverson bundle in this chunk, this self-funding line IS counted in the cover's line 1 (104.31 = line1-THIS exactly), so no exclusion adjustment was needed; it is flagged here because a reader comparing donors across filings should know this candidate's reported money is his own. THE DONOR ADDRESS CELL PRINTS A STREET AND A ZIP BUT NO CITY AND NO STATE, so donor_city and donor_state are left BLANK -- they were deliberately NOT backfilled from the cover, even though the cover gives St. George, Utah for that same address. Form A's 'In Kind?' column exists on this generation and was left BLANK on the one row: a blank is not an 'N', so in_kind is false only because the form marks nothing. The amount is legible; no row is blank for illegibility and neither side is a floor. Candidate street address, ZIP and home phone printed in the clear on the cover, and the donor street address and ZIP on Form A, were all discarded at read time per PRIVACY.
